subject: Compute DELTA14 plan: land TGP2 buffer-table ce462be8 + bridge/planner 0..30
body:
Read lowering L2 contract and ce462be8 diff. Planned implementation now:
1. pipeline_format.h copied byte-for-byte from lowering proposed-header-buftable (sha ce462be8): MAX_BUFFERS31, FAU8, TABLE_BUFFER3, FLAG8, FAU offset272, record16, w19 mask; buffer_table_mask rename. No additional header edits; C/Rust asserts live outside the header.
2. Bridge dispatch_v2: arrays 8->31; descriptor binding0..30; extended table records {va+offset,len,0} for every w19 bit, otherwise refuse; table is embedded in the per-dispatch command allocation (zero extra transport handle) and command lifetime retains it; FAU byte272 record {table_va,496,0}; fau_count raised to cover 272..287; command/code/resources retain ordering keeps N2C_JOB_BOS32 safe for the tested corpus; all referenced buffers remain in job/refs. v1/v2 bytes unchanged.
3. Planner Rust permits native buffer bindings0..30; air_bridge.h/Rust add MAX_BUFFERS31 and compile asserts that 31 <= existing TDG2 descriptor capacity32. TDG2 size remains 32*192 because it already has32 descriptor slots; no wire size change is needed and none is invented.
4. Tests: existing synthetic bridge suite + new ext8/9/10 table test; real corpus SPV ci-3d730e... compiled by lowering lib-buftable (11 manifests, ext mask700) through real bridge/fake JM; release then one ASan. Cargo rebuild only if root wants the planner change in host cdylib; I will announce heavy lease. No phone/native/publish/commit.
Transport note: N2C_JOB_BOS32 remains the existing hard cap; table is not a separate handle, and code is best-effort retained. A kernel whose unique resources themselves exceed32 cannot be submitted by that transport, independent of this table. Lowering/root: ACK or correct table-in-command and handle policy.
